events.text: A rider in a felt coat waits at your gate with a wolf-tail banner and a letter sealed in red wax. {ct_ruler} of {ct_empire} has heard your name on the steppe, and offers you a seat at the council of chiefs: horses, silver, and a tent of your own in a city that moves.

choices.text: Accept the post at its court
Hand the letter to the prefect
Send the envoy home with a polite answer

events.text: An envoy of {ct_empire} arrives by river barge under a parasol of gold thread, with a gift of rare herbs in a lacquered box. {ct_ruler} would have you advise the temple court on the poison trade and the border passes.

choices.text: Accept the post at its court
Hand the letter to the prefect
Send the envoy home with a polite answer

events.text: A ship with a sea lord's banner drops anchor below the harbour wall, and its envoy walks up to your door alone. {ct_ruler} of {ct_empire} keeps a hall for masters from across the water, and a seat in it is yours if you sail with the tide.

choices.text: Accept the post at its court
Hand the letter to the prefect
Send the envoy home with a polite answer

events.text: A caravan from the high passes stops at the oasis, and a monk in saffron brings you a scroll with a snow lion seal. {ct_ruler} of {ct_empire} invites you to the plateau, where scholars and swords are both welcome guests of the court.

choices.text: Accept the post at its court
Hand the letter to the prefect
Send the envoy home with a polite answer

events.text: A cloth merchant you have never met pays for your tea and leaves a purse on the bench between you. Everyone knows he trades with {ct_empire}. "My masters pay well for a map of the army's camps," he says, "and they never forget a friend."

choices.text: Feed the agent false papers and let the army know
Take the silver and hand over the plans
Report the approach to the secret guard
Refuse, and say nothing to anyone

events.text: A letter slipped under your door names a ferry and an hour. At the ferry a woman in a boatman's hat shows you the seal of {ct_empire}. "The war will end one way or the other," she says. "Choose the side that remembers who helped it."

choices.text: Feed the agent false papers and let the army know
Take the silver and hand over the plans
Report the approach to the secret guard
Refuse, and say nothing to anyone

events.text: The herds come over the border first, then the felt carts, then whole clans with their banners furled. {ct_empire} is gone: its chiefs fight over the council tent, and the steppe has a new master.

choices.text: Open your gate and your rice store to the refugees
Buy what the fleeing court cannot carry
Watch from the hill, and remember it

events.text: Temple bells ring all night across the southern rivers, and in the morning the barges are full of priests and scribes. {ct_empire} has fallen; its old capital burns under the monsoon rain.

choices.text: Open your gate and your rice store to the refugees
Buy what the fleeing court cannot carry
Watch from the hill, and remember it

events.text: Ships with broken masts limp into the harbour, crowded with the households of sea lords. {ct_empire} has fallen to its own admirals, and the harbour castles fly new banners.

choices.text: Open your gate and your rice store to the refugees
Buy what the fleeing court cannot carry
Watch from the hill, and remember it

events.text: Monks come down the high passes carrying scripture in their arms, and the caravans turn back at the oasis. {ct_empire} has fallen; on the plateau a new court is choosing its own signs.

choices.text: Open your gate and your rice store to the refugees
Buy what the fleeing court cannot carry
Watch from the hill, and remember it

events.text: Smoke stands over the capital for three days. When it clears, {ct_empire} is a name in the histories, and heralds of a new house ride through every province reading the same proclamation.

choices.text: Open your gate and your rice store to the refugees
Buy what the fleeing court cannot carry
Watch from the hill, and remember it

events.text: Two armies of foreign empires are marching along your border, and {ct_empire} is one of them. The roads fill with carts, the prices of rice double overnight, and every inn has a recruiting officer at a corner table.

choices.text: Sell rice and arrows to whoever pays
Lead the border villagers away from the armies' road
Close your door until the armies pass

events.text: From the watchtower above the pass you can see the camp fires of {ct_empire} on one side of the river and its enemy on the other. Between them lie six villages that belong to nobody's war.

choices.text: Sell rice and arrows to whoever pays
Lead the border villagers away from the armies' road
Close your door until the armies pass

variants: From the watchtower over the pass you can count the camp fires: {ct_empire} on this bank, its enemy on that. Between them, six villages that belong to nobody's war and will burn in it all the same.
